graph.label: scatter of every unit with mean and 95 % confidence interval

ddcq.label: ΔΔCq (efficiency assumed 2.0), Welch's t test on log2

linear_student.label: 2^-ΔΔCq per sample, Student's t test on the linear scale

linear_welch.label: 2^-ΔΔCq per sample, Welch's t test on the linear scale

test.label: Welch's unpaired t test (two-sided) on log2 relative quantities, one value per biological unit
why: Welch's t test does not assume that the two groups vary equally, and it is the test qPilot's engine used on the same log2 values, so Prism's p-values match the record.
The groups hold {{f_n_hi}} and {{f_n_lo}} biological units; technical replicates are averaged within a unit and never counted as n.

The usual spreadsheet route changes conclusions on these plates: {{f_n_differ_route_ddcq}} of {{f_n_genes}} genes with an assumed efficiency, {{f_n_differ_route_linear_welch}} with Welch's test on the linear scale and {{f_n_differ_route_linear_student}} with Student's test on the linear scale.
